mapper.select: SELECT symbol, market_cap, per, pbr, eps, dividend_yield, beta, week52_high, week52_low, industry, country, web_url, ipo_date, logo_url, shares_outstanding, synced_at FROM stock_metrics WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_metrics (symbol, market_cap, per, pbr, eps, dividend_yield, beta, week52_high, week52_low, industry, country, web_url, ipo_date, logo_url, shares_outstanding, synced_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{marketCap}, #{per}, #{pbr}, #{eps}, #{dividendYield}, #{beta}, #{week52High}, #{week52Low}, #{industry}, #{country}, #{webUrl}, #{ipoDate}, #{logoUrl}, #{sharesOutstanding}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market_cap = VALUES(market_cap), per = VALUES(per), pbr = VALUES(pbr), eps = VALUES(eps), dividend_yield = VALUES(dividend_yield), beta = VALUES(beta), week52_high = VALUES(week52_high), week52_low = VALUES(week52_low), industry = VALUES(industry), country = VALUES(country), web_url = VALUES(web_url), ipo_date = VALUES(ipo_date), logo_url = VALUES(logo_url), shares_outstanding = VALUES(shares_outstanding), synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
